id1.description: To record the result of a laboratory test which may be used to record a single valued test but will often be specialised or templated to represent multiple value or 'panel' tests.  This archetype also acts as the parent for specialisations appropriate for more specific laboratory tests microbiology, histopathology.

id6.description: Specific identifier for this lab test. e.g. Full blood count , blood glucose, urine microbiology.  May equate to the result name for a single value result. Commonly a coded term e.g from LOINC or SNOMED-CT.
